name: next-line-char-on-checkbox-line
note: Accepted divergence, surface 1 of 2. U+0085 is an ordinary character to JavaScript's `.` and a line terminator to Java's, so the checkbox line is a task to TypeScript and not to Kotlin. Retained rather than fixed: closing it means spelling an identical negated character class into both engines' (.+), in the parser's two most load-bearing patterns, for a character with no natural source in a task list.

kotlin.reason: Java's regex engine treats U+0085 as a line terminator, so (.+) cannot span it to reach the absolute end anchor and CHECKBOX_RE does not match. No task is counted. Accepted - see the task-parser spec.
